head: 8d94baff
subject: Literal RDS request header additions and removals
change: Route-level request_headers_to_add and request_headers_to_remove are decoded into the retained route model and carried in the per-RPC selection. The owned shared request-input copy applies removals first, then additions in listed order, supporting append, add-if-absent, overwrite and overwrite-if-exists. Names match case-insensitively. Only non-binary application metadata is mutable: pseudo-headers, content-type, te, grpc-* and -bin names fail validation. Values containing '%' fail validation because format substitution is not implemented; empty values are dropped unless keep_empty_value is set.

tests.decode_and_selection: src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS owns literal request header mutations and removals' checks the decoded action, retained route fields and selection projection; 'gRPC RDS rejects reserved, binary and format request header mutations' covers fail-closed validation.
tests.owned_inputs: src/grpc/channel/shared/request_inputs.zig 'shared request inputs apply xDS header mutations and removals' exercises append, overwrite, add-if-absent, overwrite-if-exists and removal against the owned metadata copy.

notes: Response header mutations and HTTP filter overrides remain unsupported. The mutation descriptor is cleared by the owned-input copy, so retries and hedged attempts apply it exactly once.
